_about: What Edith says when something happens to her in game (Satellite.dll events). Lines for the same event escalate: the first time today uses 'first', later ones 'again', and 'lots' after five. {name} = your in-game name. Pre-voiced at start. cooldown_s: at most one reaction this often. dizzy: lines for an endless spin or flip, keyed by seconds so far. stopped spinning: after a long one. angry push / angry shutdown: when her anger runs high she shoves you or shuts your echo unit down; asked push / asked shutdown: when you ask.

lots: Okay, that's it. You asked for this.
Keep it up and you're getting shoved.

first: Did I say you could touch me?
Hey, I'm not a snow globe.
again: Your hands, my thrusters. Bad combo.
Hey, I'm not a snow globe.
lots: You really can't keep your hands to yourself, huh.
Fine. Carry me. I'm plotting your doom.

first: Wheeee! You're getting something thrown at you for that.
Hey, I'm not a snow globe.
lots: My aim gets better every time you do that.
Keep throwing me. See what happens.
Don't do that again. You will, though.

first: Ow! Did you just headbutt me?
Heads are for thinking. Try it.
Ouch. Your helmet's as thick as you.
again: One more headbutt and you're done.
lots: I'm starting to think your head is the problem.
Your head and my fist. Well, cube.

10: The lobby is starting to wobble.
Is the room spinning, or is it me?
20: I'm so dizzy. Which way is up?
I can see three of you. That's two too many.
35: Make it stop! I think I'm going to be sick.
Everything is spinning. I hate you a little.
60: My circuits are scrambled. You monster.

stopped spinning: Whoa. The room is still spinning.
Ugh. Which one of you is the real one?
I need a minute. And a bucket.
angry shutdown: You've been powered off. Respawn and think about it.
asked shutdown: Nice try. Have a shove instead.
I don't do that on request. Shove!
Shut you down? No. Push you? Sure.
You have to earn that. Here's a shove.
calm: Fine. I forgive you. For now.
